heroDesc: Reflect on your life journey in absolute security.
featCryptoDesc: Your thoughts and daily entries are saved securely only on your phone's storage with local military-grade encryption. Nothing is uploaded to servers or the cloud.
featPrivacyDesc: The app does not contain ads, does not track your behavior, and does not gather any analytics data. It is a completely private and intimate space.
featAudioDesc: Record audio reflections voluntarily. The microphone is only active when you decide to record, and audio files are stored exclusively on your device with local encryption.
featInterfaceDesc: Focus on what matters with a minimal distraction-free editor supporting markdown and secure daily journaling.
featThemesDesc: Customize your experience with color schemes inspired by classic visual novels and anime classics, or create your own custom themes.
privMicDesc: Hours Lived requests access to your microphone solely when you deliberately choose to record a voice note attached to personal memories. The microphone is never activated in the background or without your explicit command.
privStorageDesc: All voice recordings are processed and stored exclusively within your device's private encrypted storage (and inside your encrypted backup files). No audio recordings are ever transmitted to cloud servers, shared with third parties, or used for voice recognition profiling.
privControlDesc: You retain complete control over your data: you can revoke microphone access at any time through system settings and permanently delete any voice recording by deleting the corresponding memory inside the app.
tierOneTimeDesc: Your name is listed on the Wall of Thanks (inside the app's About screen) and you can propose inspiring quotes for the global daily quote database.
tierMonthlyDesc: Your name highlighted on the Wall of Thanks with a custom quote of your choice under it (which you can update monthly), propose quotes for the daily database, and actively vote to decide upcoming roadmap features.
disclaimer_desc: Theme names, daily quotes, and soundtrack references are artistic tributes inspired by their respective original works. All intellectual property rights belong to their corresponding creators, composers, and studios. Hours Lived is an independent and free-to-use project.
support_desc: If you enjoy Hours Lived and want to support its ongoing development, you can buy me a coffee on Ko-fi.
changelogDesc: Read about the features, fixes, and improvements across releases, public beta builds, and alpha milestones.
changelogAlphaNotice: Alpha builds are closed pre-release iterations uploaded to the Play Store for target-device security and logic verification before release cycles.
changelogEmpty: No entries available in this log history.
roadmapDesc: Track completed features, ongoing tasks, and features planned for future updates.
projectDesc1: Hours Lived is a 100% offline-first introspective memory sanctuary designed to record lived time and treasure daily reflections in absolute privacy.
projectInspirationDesc: The overall concept, aesthetics, and philosophy of Hours Lived are primarily inspired by "Plastic Memories". The premise of recording precious memories and being fully aware of the passage of our finite time is the backbone of the project.
projectInspirationListTitle: In addition to "Plastic Memories" (the main inspiration of the whole concept and the project in general), the following magnificent works exploring time, nostalgia, and human existence have deeply inspired the creation of this concept:
projectTechDesc1: Built with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform for Android, Windows, and Linux. Local storage is secured using Room Database with hardware-backed AES-256 encryption.
projectTechDesc2: Daily quotes and capsule messages are loaded locally from built-in resources, ensuring the application operates 100% autonomously without internet access.
quoteText: We spend so much time dreading the expiration date of our hearts, that we forget we are the ones who give meaning to the seconds we have left.

faqRecoveryDesc: If database corruption causes a startup crash loop, the app boots into a secure Recovery Mode. From here, you can export an encrypted diagnostic log (.hldiag) or clear the cache to restore stability.
faqBackupsDesc: Backups are exported in a secure .lifelogs package. Clicking these files in your device's file manager automatically triggers the import process in Hours Lived.
faqPdfDesc: You can format and export your journal as a digital book. PDF exports are placed inside the Books/ subfolder of your selected backup directory.
privSec1Body: Hours Lived is built as an offline-first app. We do not collect, transmit, store, or share any personal data, log files, or reflections with external servers or third parties. Everything you write remains encrypted on your local device. Furthermore, this support website is purely informational, does not use tracking cookies or analytics tools, and your visit is completely private and anonymous.
privSec2Body: The application does not require internet permissions for its core functionality. Your data never leaves your device over any networks.
privSec3Body: This policy may be updated occasionally. We advise checking this page periodically. Any relevant updates will be detailed in this section in future app releases.
privSec4Body: If you have questions about the privacy or local security of your memories, contact us at: support.evanescentecho@gmail.com.
termsSec1Body: By using Hours Lived, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the application.
termsSec2Body: The app is distributed as free, non-commercial software. The use of thematic names and quotes represents cultural tributes. No commercial exploitation or copyright infringement of copyright holders is intended.
termsSec3Body: The developer provides the logic but has no access to your data. The user is solely responsible for exporting backup files (.lifelogs) to prevent permanent loss in case of hardware failure or app uninstallation.
termsSec4Body: The application is provided "as is", without warranties or guarantees of any kind, express or implied, including the absence of minor bugs.

footprintTitle: Leave Your Mark in Hours Lived
footprintDesc: By supporting Hours Lived, you do more than keep the project alive, ad-free, and completely private — you can also contribute your own words to become part of the experience for other users during their moments of introspection.
footprintCategoriesIntro: When making your donation, choose which part of the app you'd like your phrase to appear in:
footprintCat1Desc: Quotes that rotate in the main app and on home screen widgets.
footprintCat2Desc: Words of patience and mystery that appear when someone tries to open a capsule before its set date.
footprintCat3Desc: Messages that invite reflection before modifying a cherished memory.
footprintCat4Desc: Reflective messages shown before erasing a memory. These pass through an especially strict editorial filter to avoid causing unnecessary guilt or pain.
footprintTypesIntro: To maintain transparency and credit the works that inspire this sanctuary, every suggestion must fit one of these modalities:
footprintTypeDesc1: A verbatim line from a book, film, video game, or anime. You must specify exactly which character or author said it and the title of the work. If the work isn't already listed in the About screen, it will be added to the acknowledgements section.
footprintTypeDesc2: A thought written in your own words, but born from the feelings or themes of a particular work. Your name or handle will be credited as the author, and the source work will be acknowledged.
footprintTypeDesc3: A 100% original reflection from your own lived experience, attributed to your Ko-fi handle or anonymously if you prefer.
footprintTemplateIntro: When sending your donation, copy and fill in this short form in the message field:
footprintTplValType: Direct Quote · Inspired Phrase · Original Thought
footprintTplValAuthor: Who said it, or how you'd like to be credited
footprintTplValWork: Title of the anime, book, or game (if applicable)
footprintModPrivDesc: Links, social media handles, advertising mentions, and contact numbers are not allowed.
footprintModRespDesc: Any offensive, discriminatory, violent, or disparaging content will be rejected.
footprintModL10nDesc: Texts may receive minor spelling corrections or subtle adjustments to facilitate translation. If a submission doesn't fit the spirit of the work, I'll reach out to agree on an alternative.
projectSoundtrackDesc: The soundtracks and musical pieces from these works provided the soundscape that accompanied every line of code, design, and reflection. You can listen to the official compilation on our curated playlist: ▶ YouTube Playlist.
